clues: Very old southern beech and podocarp trees grow in a landscape repeatedly reshaped by ice.
An alpine parrot and a rare flightless bird are part of the wildlife described for this protected region.
The Alpine Fault marks a major plate boundary running through the wider landscape.
Successive glaciations shaped its fjords, rocky coasts, lakes and waterfalls.
